metadata.description: The Canary E-cad plugin marketplace for EPLAN Electric P8 and EEC Pro: agent skills for scripting, the EPLAN API and Remote Client, plus the documentation RAG MCP servers.

plugins.name: eplan
plugins.description: EPLAN Electric P8: the router plus the P8 skill (scripting, API and Remote Client) and the two P8 documentation RAG MCP servers. EEC Pro is a separate plugin: install eec-pro as well.

plugins.name: eplan-scripting
plugins.description: EPLAN Electric P8 only: C# scripting, the EPLAN API (parts database, 3D), Remote Client automation, verified action parameters and production pitfalls. Covers EPLAN 2022-2027.

plugins.name: eec-pro
plugins.description: EPLAN EEC Pro 2026: typicals and the mechatronic model, the formula language, configuration interfaces, Groovy actions and P8 post-generation scripts, the EOX model file, the Job Server (recipes, triggers, workers, REST, timing), and generation into P8 / Pro Panel / PLC / text targets. Includes the EEC Pro documentation RAG MCP server.
